messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Implemented named game snapshots and more flexible snapshot loading.

- Added a **Deal name** field. Names stay with the current game, appear in version 2 exports, and return on import. Fresh deals and unnamed version 1 imports clear the name; names aren’t saved in preferences.
- Snapshot import now accepts versions 1 and 2 regardless of JSON field order, while preserving exact field and progress validation.
- I didn’t run the project checks.

Key changes are in [Reproduction.tsx](/work/src/game/controls/Reproduction.tsx), [snapshot.ts](/work/src/game/snapshot.ts), and [use-game.ts](/work/src/game/session/use-game.ts).
